objective: Train small direct query head with public YCB-V and synthetic data; compare frozen v61; separate external/self/query-error diagnostics; no PnP.
status: source training and source-only model selection underway; current evaluation inference not started

labels.external_support: full target silhouette=1 and visible target=0
labels.outside_support: full=0, including background/holes; never rename as occlusion
labels.semantic_self: human native-keypoint state is evaluation only; source full/visible masks do not supply this
labels.geometric_self: separate fixed saved-initial-pose proxy, never overwrite learned p_visible
labels.query_error: evaluation-only distance to frozen reference; not a neural input or crop correction

data.YCB_query_sampler: source-only mask-stratified supervised point queries + rough bbox jitter; source annotation-derived crop scale jitter. Explicit input-distribution difference from deployment N0 coordinates.
data.current_eval_role: inference and diagnostics only; no fit/statistics/calibration/threshold/checkpoint selection

small_head.spatial_center: two conv/GELU + 1x1 spatial map read at[4,4], no GAP
small_head.target_context: 64-channel valid-weighted mean over all8query ROI; identical input-only calculation in train and deployment
small_head.optional_RGB: 65x65 crop centered on nearest query pixel; independent pixel-center audit; source-only selection
small_head.backbone: existing frozen YOLO26 P3; BN unchanged
small_head.RGB_alignment: RGB feature grid sampled at native P3 nine positions, normalized [-8/9,8/9]; V2 endpoint pilot retained and excluded

training.checkpoint_selection: strict lowest mean of per-source VAL BCE, every100updates

source_only_SAM_baseline.checkpoint: frozen generic public MobileSAM, no historical CAL wrapper
source_only_SAM_baseline.prompt: box only from available source/deployment rough target bounds; never GT mask or query-positive click
source_only_SAM_baseline.role: source validation comparison and optional frozen inference baseline

evaluation_gate: Freeze source-selected models/checkpoint hashes/thresholds before any current223 new-model scoring. Report all predesignated frozen comparisons, raw p_visible and geometric proxy separately.
preservation: v61/legacy checkpoints, original inputs, bad/pilot runs kept; no PnP/pose optimization or pose replacement

amendments.reason: source code review found RGB auxiliary grid endpoint mismatch; scalar center was aligned. Corrected before any private evaluation.
